title: Workspace.Unmount result
description: Per protocol-v0.md §7.3. `drained` keeps its v0 meaning (the daemon accepted the release). `unmounted` names the root that was released — null when the request named no mounted root, since a duplicate unmount is a no-op rather than an error. `mounted_roots` lists what the daemon still serves.

unmounted.description: `workspace_id` of the released root, or null when no mounted root matched the request.

workspace_root.description: Canonical path of the released root, or null.

mounted_roots.description: Every workspace root the daemon still serves, in mount order.
